basis.note: Scenario ranges bracket recently reported voluntary-market prices for nature-based removal (ARR) credits. They are placeholders for local price discovery and must be reviewed each release against the World Bank "State and Trends of Carbon Pricing" and Ecosystem Marketplace reports.

references.title: World Bank — State and Trends of Carbon Pricing (annual)

basis.region_note: India's CCTS offset market and the Green Credit Programme have no public, liquid price for agroforestry removals yet; values are global voluntary ranges converted to INR.
